NISHAT

# D.G. KHAN CEMENT COMPANY LIMITED

Reglonal Office: D.G. House, D-247 K.D.A. Scheme Number 1/A, Karachi-Pakistan.

Tel: (92-21) 34935030, 5040, Fax: (92-21) 34935362

E-mail: zdin.khi@dgcement.com

July 01, 2024

Subject: Price Increase Effective 01-07-2024 Due to FED and GST Increases in Federal Budget:

Dear Customer:

We would like to inform you that on Monday, 01-07-2024, the Ex-Factory prices of D.G. Khan Cement's OPC, SRC and Block brands will be increased by Rs. 2,500 per ton or Rs. 125 per bag for all Projects & Institutional Customers. This adjustment is due to the increase in Federal Excise Duty (FED) and General Sales Tax (GST) as announced by the Government of Pakistan in the Federal Budget.

While we have always aimed to minimize the impact of production costs on our valuable customers, this price increase is unavoidable at this time. Please note that this increase will be applied uniformly across Karachi, Sindh, and Baluchistan. The new prices will be effective for all dispatches made from the above mentioned date.

Additionally, all existing bookings, and purchase orders issued by the customers prior to this announcement will be considered cancelled.

For further information or any queries regarding this change, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Thank you for your understanding.

Best regards,

Adeel Sheikh

Manager Sales & Marketing

D G. Khan Cement Co. Ltd

Ziauddin

Dy. General Manager (Sales & Marketing)

D G. Khan Cement Co. Ltd

Nishat House, 53-A, Lawrence Road, Lahore - Pakistan. UAN: (92-42) 111 113 333, Tel: (92-42) 6367812, Fax: (92-42) 6367414
